item.title: A little pride wouldn't hurt...
item.description: This photo taken by a concerned Amsterdam resident of discarded trash is a sure sign that we need to renew pride in our communities.Yes, it could have been an accident- but wouldn't one notice it was missing upon arrival at their destination? #MidAmericaLive

item.title: Harrisonville Elementary Students of the Month

item.title: Butler's oldest business set to close soon
item.description: We are saddened to learn that LeNeve's TV and Appliance will be closing their doors permanently in the near future. We wish Don and Tommy the best with many thanks for 70 years of your commitment to our community.This would be an EXCELLENT time to get a great deal as inventory liquidation has begun! #MidAmericaLive

item.title: Obituary - Richard Dean Sheppard
item.description: Richard Dean Sheppard age 68 of Holden, Missouri departed this life Sunday, February 22, 2026 at Saint Luke's East, Lee's Summit, Missouri. Cremation with a Celebration of life will be held at a later date. A complete obituary will be posted once that information becomes available, courtesy Dickey Funeral Home. #MidAmericaLive

item.title: Bates County candidates set for August election
item.description: Candidate filing opened at 8 a.m. this morning for the Primary Election that will be held on August 4th. As of 10:15 this morning we have had 6 candidates file. Filing closes on March 31st at 5:00 p.m. We will update our Facebook page with any new candidates as they file. Associate Circuit Judge Julie Highley (R)Circuit Clerk Shelli White (R)Presiding Commissioner Chris Gach (R)Jim Wheatley (R)County Clerk Jami Page (R)Recorder of Deeds Danyelle Baker (R) #MidAmericaLive

item.title: Obituary - Frederick “Norvell” Kemper
item.description: Frederick “Norvell” Kemper, 96, formerly of Freeman, Missouri, passed away on Sunday, February 22, 2026 in Leawood, Kansas. Graveside services will be held on Friday, February 27, 2026, at 11:00 AM at Freeman Cemetery in Freeman, MO. A Celebration of Life will be held at Freeman Presbyterian Church from 1:00 PM to 3:00 PM on Friday, February 27, 2026. item.title: Cody Johnson in the running for Bates County Prosecuting Attorney
item.description: Cody L. Johnson has filed to run for the office of Bates County Prosecuting Attorney. Cody graduated with honors from Avila University with a bachelor’s degree in criminology/criminal justice. In 2017, he graduated with honors from Case Western Reserve University School of Law in Cleveland, OH. He passed the Bar exam that same summer and began his law career as a Public Defender out of the Harrisonville District 17 office, serving Johnson, Cass, Bates, Henry and St. Clair Counties. item.title: Obituary - Denise "Renee" Speedone
item.description: Denise "Renee" Speedone, 59, of Dunnegan, Missouri, formerly of Adrian, MO, passed away on Sunday, February 22, 2026, at her home. Funeral services will be held on Friday, February 27, 2026, at 3:00 PM at Atkinson Funeral Home in Adrian, MO, with a visitation from 2:00-3:00 PM. A full obituary will be posted when it becomes available. #MidAmericaLive
